description: This file contains utility functions for creating and manipulating editor components, including DOM element creation, editor setup, and list item generation, used within the Notesnook project.

methods.name: createEditor
methods.description: Creates and configures a new editor instance with specified extensions and initial content.

methods.name: h
methods.description: Creates an HTML element with specified children and attributes.

methods.name: text
methods.description: Creates a text node with the given string.

methods.name: outlineList
methods.description: Generates an unordered list element with data-type 'outlineList'.

methods.name: outlineListItem
methods.description: Creates a list item with a paragraph and optional sublist, marked as 'outlineListItem'.

methods.name: taskItem
methods.description: Creates a checklist item with optional checked state and sublist.

methods.name: checkList
methods.description: Creates a simple checklist unordered list.

methods.name: checkListItem
methods.description: Creates a checklist list item with optional sublist.
